brief: 後端寫入知識圖譜紀錄時一筆一筆去查資料庫，平常無感，大批搬遷時會明顯拖慢。
detail: GraphEventStore.insert_many still does one session.get(GraphEvent, event_id) per entry (backend/src/kg/graph_event_log.py:134) — the exact twin of the per-entry existence check just batched out of ReviewEventStore.insert_many. Both ledgers deliberately share sqlite_ledger.py (normalize_last_ingested / next_ingested_at) precisely so they do not drift; fixing only the review-events half re-introduces the divergence that module exists to prevent. Lower urgency than the review-events case because graph events are server-emitted (graph_history_synth.py, sot_history_migrate.py) rather than re-sent wholesale by a watermark-less client — but sot_history_migrate backfill batches can be large. Fix: mirror _existing_event_ids (chunked IN, chunk under SQLite's pre-3.32 999-variable ceiling) plus the in-loop known-ids add that preserves the intra-batch duplicate guard.
plan: 整段照抄 backend/src/kg/review_events.py 已落地的形狀（commit cbc0d1c61），不要另創寫法——這兩個帳本刻意共用 sqlite_ledger.py 就是為了不 drift。① graph_event_log.py 模組層加 `_EXISTS_QUERY_CHUNK = 500`（與 review_events.py:29 同值同理由：低於 SQLite 3.32 前的 999 變數上限）。② 加 `def _existing_event_ids(self, session: Session, event_ids: list[str]) -> set[str]:`，內容鏡射 review_events.py:119-139——`for start in range(0, len(event_ids), _EXISTS_QUERY_CHUNK)` 分塊，每塊跑 `session.exec(select(GraphEvent.event_id).where(GraphEvent.event_id.in_(chunk))).all()` 並 update 進 set。③ insert_many 內，在取完 `last_ingested` 之後、`for d in drafts` 之前呼叫 `known_ids = self._existing_event_ids(session, [d.event_id for d in drafts])`，把 :134 的 `if session.get(GraphEvent, d.event_id) is not None:` 換成 `if d.event_id in known_ids:`；**並在 `inserted += 1` 之前補一行 `known_ids.add(d.event_id)`**——這行不能省，原本的 per-entry `session.get` 靠 autoflush 順帶擋掉「同一批 drafts 內重覆的 event_id」，改成批次預查後只有它擋得住（review_events.py:152-154 的註解就是在說這件事）。④ backend/tests/test_graph_event_log.py 依 backend/tests/test_review_events.py:279-322 的形狀補兩支測試：`_count_graphevent_selects(store, drafts)`（用 sqlalchemy `before_cursor_execute` listener 數落在 graph events 表上的 SELECT）與 `test_duplicate_insert_existence_check_does_not_scale_with_batch_size`（20 筆 vs 200 筆各自重推，assert 小批 SELECT 數 ≤ 4 且 `large - small <= 2`），再加一支同批次重覆 event_id 仍被 skip 的測試。呼叫端（graph_history_synth.py、sot_history_migrate.py）不需要改。
scope: 後端一支檔案照著另一支已修好的同型寫法改，再補三個測試。
